nodes.label: requireAdmin
nodes.summary: Auth gate: validates app_metadata.role==='admin', redirects to /login otherwise. Returns {supabase,user}. Trusts only app_metadata, never user_metadata.

nodes.label: sendPlacementInvoice
nodes.summary: Admin action: transitions placement confirmed/guarantee_active -> invoice_sent, notifies company + recruiter.

nodes.label: recordPlacementPayment
nodes.summary: Admin action: invoice_sent -> guarantee_active or payout_released depending on guarantee_end_date; updates candidate status.

nodes.label: processGuaranteeExpirations
nodes.summary: Admin batch: releases payout for all guarantee_active placements past end date, marks candidate completed, notifies, recalculates metrics.

nodes.label: reportGuaranteeFailure
nodes.summary: Admin action: guarantee_active -> guarantee_failed, sets refund_amount, marks candidate completed, notifies.

nodes.label: recalculateRecruiterMetrics
nodes.summary: Admin action: calls RPC fn_recalculate_recruiter_metrics for one recruiter.

nodes.label: recalculateAllRecruiterMetrics
nodes.summary: Admin batch: loops approved recruiters and recalculates metrics each.

nodes.label: getRecruiterPerformanceMetrics
nodes.summary: Recruiter read: returns own perf_* columns; deliberately avoids requireAdmin.

nodes.label: getPlacementByCandidateId
nodes.summary: Admin read: placement row by candidate_id.

nodes.label: getAdminPlacements
nodes.summary: Admin read: all placements joined with candidate/job/company/recruiter.

nodes.label: createCandidate
nodes.summary: Recruiter action: validates mandate ownership, dedupe/identity check, CV MIME-content check, enforces max_candidates cap, inserts candidate, auto-pauses job at cap.

nodes.label: updateCandidateStatus
nodes.summary: Recruiter-only status transition with state-machine guard; placement automation hooks (auto-invoice on invoice_enabled), metrics recalculation, markJobFilledAndReject on hired.

nodes.label: moveCandidateToPipelineStage
nodes.summary: Recruiter action: validates target stage in job pipeline, maps stage type to candidate_status, notifies/emails.

nodes.label: updateCompanyStage
nodes.summary: Company-only action: sets company_stage, syncs candidate.status (offer/hire/reject), emails recruiter, fills job on hired.

nodes.label: requestCandidateNextStep
nodes.summary: Company-only action: records company_requested_next_step and notifies recruiter.

nodes.label: markOfferAccepted
nodes.summary: Company-only action: status -> offer_accepted when company_stage='job_offer'.

nodes.label: markCandidateRecruitoScreened
nodes.summary: Admin action: sets recruito_screened_at/by — the client-visibility divider.

nodes.label: rejectCandidateAtScreening
nodes.summary: Admin action: status -> recruito_rejected before client view, notifies submitting recruiter.

nodes.label: getActorRoleForCandidateAction
nodes.summary: Helper: resolves whether current user is company or recruiter for a candidate+job, IDOR check via job_id match.

nodes.label: createCandidateExtended
nodes.summary: Recruiter action: extended-fields candidate insert with mandate ownership, dedupe, CV MIME-content validation, client-engagement check; rejects duplicates outright.

nodes.label: getNotifications
nodes.summary: Read own latest 20 notifications scoped by user.id.

nodes.label: markAsRead
nodes.summary: Mark one notification read, scoped by user.id (IDOR-safe).

nodes.label: markAllAsRead
nodes.summary: Mark all own unread notifications read.

nodes.label: sendMessage
nodes.summary: Resolves recruiter/company participants from candidate, authorizes membership, self-heals conversation_participants, inserts message, fans out notification to the other party.

nodes.label: sendRecruitorMessage
nodes.summary: Inserts message into the 'recruito' conversation for a candidate, creating it if absent.

nodes.label: getConversations
nodes.summary: Aggregates conversations for current user via participants, hydrates candidate/job/company/profiles using admin client.

nodes.label: getCandidateConversation
nodes.summary: Reads a candidate's client/recruito conversation with messages+sender profiles.

nodes.label: getUnreadMessageCount
nodes.summary: Counts messages newer than last_read_at not sent by the user.

nodes.label: markConversationAsRead
nodes.summary: Updates conversation_participants.last_read_at for current user.

nodes.label: getAdminStats
nodes.summary: Admin dashboard counts + revenue (platform fee) aggregation over placements.

nodes.label: approveRecruiter
nodes.summary: Admin action: gated on KYC checklist completeness, sets approval_status=approved + approved_by/at + kyc_checklist.

nodes.label: rejectRecruiter
nodes.summary: Admin action: approval_status=rejected with reason.

nodes.label: suspendRecruiter
nodes.summary: Admin action: approval_status=suspended.

nodes.label: reactivateRecruiter
nodes.summary: Admin action: re-approve suspended/rejected recruiter without full KYC.

nodes.label: requestClientFeeReconfirm
nodes.summary: Admin action: job pending_approval/pending_client_reconfirm -> pending_client_reconfirm with proposed fee, status-guarded update, notifies + emails company.

nodes.label: withdrawClientFeeReconfirm
nodes.summary: Admin action: revert reconfirm to estimated fee, status -> active, decision='withdrawn'.

nodes.label: sendAdminNotification
nodes.summary: Admin broadcast: resolves audience user ids, sanitizes link/title (CRLF + same-origin), batch inserts notifications.

nodes.label: getCandidatesForScreening
nodes.summary: Admin read: submitted candidates not yet recruito-screened.

nodes.label: getEarningsAnalytics
nodes.summary: Admin analytics: platform revenue/recruiter payout aggregations over placements.

nodes.label: updateClientFeeAmount
nodes.summary: Admin override of locked client_fee_amount on a job.

nodes.label: claimMandate
nodes.summary: Recruiter action: requires approved status, enforces max_recruiters + max_candidates caps via active mandate rows, inserts job_mandate, notifies company.

nodes.label: getRecruiterDashboard
nodes.summary: Recruiter dashboard: parallel reads of mandates, candidate count, placements revenue, available jobs; tallies candidates per mandate.

nodes.label: getAvailableJobsForRecruiter
nodes.summary: Recruiter read: lists claimable jobs using admin client for non-PII counts; counts active mandate rows for capacity.

nodes.label: getRecruiterEarnings
nodes.summary: Recruiter read: own placements + total/paid/guarantee fee stats.

nodes.label: completeRecruiterOnboarding
nodes.summary: Recruiter action: validates onboarding form + avatar image MIME-content, updates recruiter profile, sends internal email.

nodes.label: getRecruiterApplicationsForJob
nodes.summary: Recruiter read: own applications for a job joined with ai_screenings results.

nodes.label: getJobProcessStats
nodes.summary: Recruiter read: aggregate candidate pipeline counts for a job (no PII) via admin client.

nodes.label: createJob
nodes.summary: Company action: validates form, auto-creates company if missing, computes volume-tier fee, locks client+recruiter fees, inserts job as draft or pending_approval.

nodes.label: approveJob
nodes.summary: Admin action: job pending_approval -> active + published_at (status-guarded), then notifies matching recruiters.

nodes.label: clientApproveProposedFee
nodes.summary: Company action: accepts proposed higher fee, job pending_client_reconfirm -> active, notifies recruiters.

nodes.label: clientRejectProposedFee
nodes.summary: Company action: rejects proposed fee, routes job back to pending_approval.

nodes.label: closeJob
nodes.summary: Company action: status -> closed, auto-rejects remaining candidates, notifies recruiters.

nodes.label: pauseJob
nodes.summary: Company action: active -> paused with reason, notifies recruiters.

nodes.label: resumeJob
nodes.summary: Company action: paused -> active, re-arms reopen nudge, notifies recruiters.

nodes.label: verifyJobOwnership
nodes.summary: Helper: confirms current user's company owns the job (IDOR gate for company job mutations).

nodes.label: notifyMatchingRecruitersAboutJob
nodes.summary: Helper: filters approved recruiters by industry/location match, sends notification + email per match.

nodes.label: updatePipelineStages
nodes.summary: Company action: validates stages, blocks orphaning active candidates, updates pipeline, notifies recruiters.

nodes.label: exportMyData
nodes.summary: GDPR Art.20: admin-client dump of every row referencing user.id, scoped by user.id.

nodes.label: requestAccountErasure
nodes.summary: GDPR Art.17: inserts data_rights_requests (erasure) + audit_log entry, blocks duplicate pending.

nodes.label: markDataRightsRequestComplete
nodes.summary: Admin action: resolves data_rights_request completed/rejected + audit_log.

nodes.label: anonymizeCandidate
nodes.summary: Admin action: removes CV from storage, calls RPC anonymize_candidate.

nodes.label: getPendingDataRightsRequests
nodes.summary: Admin read: pending/in_progress data_rights_requests with subject profile.

nodes.label: buildEvaluationPrompt
nodes.summary: Phase 1: mandate-authorized; gathers eval data, fills prompt, returns clipboard payload + signed CV URL.

nodes.label: saveMandateEvalConfig
nodes.summary: Mandate-authorized: persists per-mandate eval_* config onto job_mandates.

nodes.label: getLatestEvaluation
nodes.summary: Phase 2: reads latest candidate_screenings report for candidate+mandate.

nodes.label: authorizeMandate (lib/screening/eval-data)
nodes.summary: External auth helper used by all screening actions; returns {admin} or {error}. Mandate-scoped gate.

nodes.label: submitPublicMandateApplication
nodes.summary: Public action: honeypot, zod validate, IP rate-limit, consent, dedupe by email/linkedin, CV MIME-content check, inserts application via admin client.

nodes.label: reviewApplication
nodes.summary: Recruiter action: authenticates + binds recruiterId to own row (IDOR), calls atomic approve_application/reject_application RPC with max-7 cap.

nodes.label: getPublicMandateApplicationContext
nodes.summary: Public read: mandate+job+company context for the apply page via admin client.

nodes.label: getCompanyDashboard
nodes.summary: Company dashboard: jobs + candidate/interview/placement counts scoped by company.

nodes.label: updateCompanyProfile
nodes.summary: Company action: validates + updates companies + profile name scoped by user.id.

nodes.label: acceptCandidateProfileNotice
nodes.summary: Company action: one-time candidate_profile_notice_accepted flag.

nodes.label: getSidebarData
nodes.summary: Read: derives sidebar name/initials/role from auth user metadata.

nodes.label: registerCompany
nodes.summary: Auth: signUp role=company, admin-client inserts companies row, rolls back user on failure.

nodes.label: registerRecruiter
nodes.summary: Auth: signUp role=recruiter, admin-client inserts recruiters row, sends internal+confirmation emails, rolls back on failure.

nodes.label: placements.test.ts pinning suite
nodes.summary: Vitest pinning test mocking Supabase/requireAdmin; locks placement status state-machine for sendPlacementInvoice + recordPlacementPayment.

nodes.label: createNotification (lib/notifications/create)
nodes.summary: Shared notification fan-out primitive invoked across placements/candidates/jobs/recruiter/messages/admin actions; sanitizes link via safePath.

nodes.label: placements (table)
nodes.summary: Supabase table: placement lifecycle rows (status, fees, guarantee/payment timestamps).

nodes.label: candidates (table)
nodes.summary: Supabase table: candidate rows with status, pipeline stage, screening + recruito_screened_at visibility divider.

nodes.label: jobs (table)
nodes.summary: Supabase table: job rows with status lifecycle, locked fees, caps (max_recruiters/max_candidates).

nodes.label: recruiters (table)
nodes.summary: Supabase table: recruiter profiles, approval_status, KYC, perf_* metrics.

nodes.label: companies (table)
nodes.summary: Supabase table: company profiles linked to user_id.

nodes.label: job_mandates (table)
nodes.summary: Supabase table: recruiter-job claim rows (is_active), eval config columns.

nodes.label: notifications (table)
nodes.summary: Supabase table: per-user notification rows.

nodes.label: conversations/messages/participants (tables)
nodes.summary: Supabase messaging tables: conversations, messages, conversation_participants.

nodes.label: applications (table)
nodes.summary: Supabase table: public-apply submissions awaiting recruiter review; promoted to candidates via RPC.

nodes.label: profiles (table)
nodes.summary: Supabase table: shared user profile (full_name, email, email_opt_out, role).

nodes.label: cookie-consent
nodes.summary: Cookie-based GDPR consent state (necessary/analytics) with versioned JSON cookie, read/write helpers, and a consent-updated DOM event.

nodes.label: sanitize
nodes.summary: HTML sanitization (sanitizeRichText allows safe formatting tags; stripHtml for AI prompts/plain text) via sanitize-html.

nodes.label: mandate-stages
nodes.summary: Shared mandate stage buckets (in_review..rejected), candidate-to-stage mapping, and 10-day mandate-expiry-days-left computation.

nodes.label: job-form-options
nodes.summary: Static dropdown/select option lists for job posting form (employment, salary, benefits, industries, countries in Swedish, etc.).

nodes.label: file-magic
nodes.summary: Server-side magic-byte content validation for CV (pdf/doc/docx/rtf/txt) and image (jpg/png/webp) uploads per CLAUDE.md §6.

nodes.label: csv
nodes.summary: csvEscapeCell escapes leading =,+,-,@ to prevent CSV/formula injection per CLAUDE.md §6.

nodes.label: pricing
nodes.summary: Recruiter fee tier model (gold/silver/standard by placement count over 12-month window) and next-tier progress.

nodes.label: utils
nodes.summary: cn classname merge, currency/date formatters, and canonical client-fee/recruiter-fee math (calculateClientFee, calculateFee, floorToHundreds).

nodes.label: job-fill
nodes.summary: Server-only job lifecycle cascade: reject remaining candidates on fill/close, reopen nudge, recruiter lifecycle notifications + email.

nodes.label: app-url
nodes.summary: Async getAppUrl deriving the request-time base URL from forwarded/host headers, falling back to NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL then localhost.

nodes.label: fee-reconfirm
nodes.summary: Client-fee uplift reason list/validation and requiresReconfirm gate (final > estimated) for the fee re-confirmation flow.

nodes.label: candidate-workflow
nodes.summary: Candidate status state machine: status sets, legacy normalization, allowed transitions, timestamp patches, terminal statuses, visual workflow nodes.

nodes.label: candidate-identity
nodes.summary: Identity normalization + email/LinkedIn matching for duplicate detection and active client-engagement check.

nodes.label: guarantee
nodes.summary: computeProportionalRefund: prorated guarantee-breach refund = totalFee × remaining/total window days, clamped [0,1].

nodes.label: recruiter-onboarding-options
nodes.summary: Static option lists for recruiter onboarding (countries in English, industries, sourcing channels, etc.) + experience-bracket-to-years mapper.

nodes.label: site-url
nodes.summary: Synchronous getSiteUrl building canonical base URL purely from NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL (adds https://, strips trailing slash), localhost fallback.

nodes.label: consumeRateLimit
nodes.summary: DB-backed durable rate limiter via consume_rate_limit() RPC with in-memory fail-open fallback.

nodes.label: updateSession
nodes.summary: Next.js middleware: refreshes Supabase session, enforces protected/role-based routes, auto-detects locale.

nodes.label: createAdminClient
nodes.summary: Server-only Supabase client using the service-role key, no session persistence.

nodes.label: createClient (browser)
nodes.summary: Browser Supabase client built from the anon key.

nodes.label: createClient (server)
nodes.summary: SSR Supabase client wired to Next.js cookies, anon key.

nodes.label: createNotification
nodes.summary: Server-internal notification creator: sanitizes input, inserts notifications row, schedules email via after().

nodes.label: email dispatch (Resend/SMTP)
nodes.summary: Email transport layer: Resend primary with SMTP fallback; exports sendUserEmail + sendInternalRecruiterEmail.

nodes.label: sendNotificationEmail
nodes.summary: Looks up profile email + opt-out, renders branded HTML/text template, dispatches via sendUserEmail; never throws.

nodes.label: email-templates
nodes.summary: HTML email template builders (new job, candidate submission, progress, job lifecycle, payment, fee reconfirm) with HTML escaping.

nodes.label: validation/forms
nodes.summary: Zod schemas + FormData validators gating login, register, job, candidate, profile, and onboarding server actions.

nodes.label: fillEvaluationPrompt
nodes.summary: Fills the structured LLM screening prompt template with JD/config/metadata and assembles clipboard payload.

nodes.label: gatherEvalData / authorizeMandate
nodes.summary: Server-only: mandate auth + IDOR check and assembly of JD + candidate context (EvalConfig/ScreeningAnswer) for screening.

nodes.summary: Vitest suite pinning computeProportionalRefund behavior (3x-refund regression, proportional, expiry, missing-start fallback).

links.note: Both derive trusted role exclusively from app_metadata.role to prevent self-promotion to admin.
Two near-identical candidate-insert paths with shared dedupe/identity + CV MIME-content validation; neither calls the other.
Both enforce the per-job max_candidates submission cap with the same default-8 logic.
Two CV-intake/dedupe/MIME-content-validation paths (public-apply vs recruiter-submit) that don't call each other.
Both are role/ownership IDOR gates resolving current user against a job/candidate row.
Both compute platform-fee revenue from placements with the same platform_fee fallback formula.
Request/withdraw form the admin side of the client-fee reconfirm state machine on jobs.
Admin proposes uplift (pending_client_reconfirm); company approves it back to active via shared job columns.
Parallel role-dashboards aggregating jobs/candidates/placements counts with the same pattern.
Company accept/reject of the proposed fee on pending_client_reconfirm jobs.
User requests erasure; admin completes/rejects the same data_rights_requests row.
approve_application RPC moves an application into the candidates pipeline.

links.label: both privacy/security-adjacent client helpers, weak overlap
both neutralize untrusted user input for a downstream renderer (spreadsheet formulas vs HTML)
mandate stage buckets are aggregations over candidate-workflow status values; share the same status vocabulary
both duplicate the HIRED_PROTECTED status set and reason about which candidates remain 'live' for the client
parallel static option-list modules (overlapping COUNTRY/INDUSTRY/EXPERIENCE sets; job form Swedish vs onboarding English)
both implement CLAUDE.md §6 upload/input security guardrails (content MIME validation vs CSV injection escaping)
calculateClientFee produces the estimate that requiresReconfirm compares against the final amount
refund computed against totalFee derived from utils fee math
imports statusChangeTimestampPatch + TERMINAL_CANDIDATE_STATUSES to cascade-reject candidates
near-duplicate base-URL builders; both stripTrailingSlash + NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL, app-url is request/header-aware async, site-url is env-only sync
both consume the locked client fee — uplift reconfirm vs proportional breach refund
both are thin validators wrapping a shared type/vocabulary (uplift reasons vs identity), low coupling
imports normalizeCandidateStatusForWorkflow + TERMINAL_CANDIDATE_STATUSES for active-engagement check

links.rationale: Calls createAdminClient() to invoke the consume_rate_limit RPC.
Both wrap createServerClient with Next cookie adapters; middleware variant operates on NextRequest/Response.
vi.mock of @/lib/supabase/admin with a chainable client stub.
authorizeMandate uses the SSR client to read the authenticated user.
Dispatches the rendered email through sendUserEmail.
Both render branded HTML emails with escapeHtml; notification-email inlines its own template rather than importing email-templates.
forms.ts gates server actions broadly; screening actions consuming eval-data are likely behind such validation, but no direct link in source.
Shares EvalConfig/ScreeningAnswer types; gatherEvalData assembles the JD + config consumed by fillEvaluationPrompt for the screening flow.
